name: White River (Utah)
blurb: Quiet desert canyon float from Bonanza Bridge to the Enron take-out; Class II at most during runoff. Watch for downed cottonwoods.

sections.notes: BLM brochure: take-out 35 miles downstream; give yourself at least two days. BLM: Bonanza launch is on private property, open Apr 1-Oct 1. Enron is the last public take-out before the Uintah & Ouray Reservation (tribal permits/fees beyond).
sections.accessReview: Bonanza is on private property and BLM lists an April 1–October 1 access season. November 9 is outside that season. Map and timing remain withheld until current permission and access conditions are rechecked; an approximate location does not authorize entry.

notices.title: Bonanza: seasonal private access
notices.text: BLM lists Bonanza’s primitive launch on private property, open April 1–October 1. Check with BLM Vernal and the landowner before arranging access. The location is documented, but the trip is not currently offered outside that published season.
notices.sourceName: BLM National Recreation Site Points — Bonanza

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
